# Nexow

> Nexow is an AI-native workspace for financial markets. You describe a widget in
> plain language — a chart, table, heatmap or signal — and Nexow generates its
> source code with Anthropic's Claude, runs it in a sandboxed iframe, and streams
> live market data onto a free-form canvas. Around the canvas it adds cloud bots
> (live today), AI agents with a visual harness builder (cloud deploy coming soon),
> a workspace Copilot (coming soon) and a live maker community. It is private by
> default: in local mode, codegen runs in your browser with your own Anthropic API
> key and your widgets persist locally in IndexedDB — no account required. A free
> account is optional and unlocks cloud sync and the community today, with platform
> AI credits, a widget marketplace and XP rewards rolling out next.

## Key facts

- Category: AI-native workspace / dashboard & widget builder for trading and market data, with cloud automations (bots, sometimes described as cloud workers) and a maker community.
- How it works: prompt → AI-generated widget source → sandboxed iframe runtime → live data via connectors → refine in natural language.
- Structure: Workspaces contain Screens, which hold Widgets on a free-form canvas. Groups bundle widgets with mosaic or tab layouts; Links pipe data between widgets, one-way or two-way.
- Privacy: private by default and no account required; bring-your-own-key codegen runs client-side; widgets, versions and logs stored in the browser (IndexedDB); many venues connect browser-direct.
- Automate — Bots (LIVE): cloud automations that watch your data and fire signals and alerts to widgets with the tab closed — thresholds, % change, MA crossovers, digests, and new trades in a connected broker account; build them by describing in plain words or in a visual builder. Agents (harness builder LIVE, cloud deploy COMING SOON): design an agent with a full harness — model, memory, skills, tools, knowledge, triggers — in a visual radial builder. Copilot (COMING SOON): a workspace AI assistant that explains charts and summarizes widget data.
- Network — Community (LIVE): a social feed with follows, likes, comments, public maker profiles (@handles), and widget sharing others can add straight to their library. Marketplace for buying and selling widgets (COMING SOON — free sharing already works). Audited strategy signals (COMING SOON). XP & rewards (COMING SOON): earn XP and badges for achievements and convert them into reward credits.
- Accounts: free, no credit card. Cross-device cloud sync is LIVE; 10,000 AI credits are reserved at sign-up and activate when platform mode opens.
- Connectors (28 live, 56 in catalog): OANDA, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Deribit, BitMEX, Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Intrinio, IQFeed, Rithmic, LMAX, FXCM, Kalshi, Polymarket, Trading Economics, Postgres, ClickHouse, Qdrant, plus socials (X, YouTube, Discord, Telegram, Spotify).
- Markets covered: FX, crypto, equities, futures, options and prediction markets.
- AI models: Anthropic Claude via the Anthropic SDK — Claude Opus 4.8 (default), Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5.
- Plans: free forever to build (locally with your own key, or with 10,000 AI credits reserved on a free account). Paid plans — Supporter ($9.99/mo, 50K credits, 30 bots, 10 agents) and Sponsor ($69.99/mo, 800K credits, 300 bots, 100 agents) — plus Partner (custom, for teams). Yearly billing gives two months free. Paid checkout and platform credits are coming soon.
- Status: public preview live (canvas, codegen, connectors, cloud bots, accounts & sync, community feed). Roadmap: agent deploy, Copilot, marketplace, strategy signals, XP & rewards.
- App: https://app.nexow.ai
